svg.text: NOR output qualifies the request only when MCU request, POWER_OK2 and live VBUS_EN_SNK are all low. PWR_OK_CFG=10b; active PDO2 must be15V. POWER_OK2 alone can remain asserted after unplug.
U_MOTOR_ENN is a Schmitt-input NAND: ENN is low only with a qualified request AND supervisor power-good. R7 uses TMC VCC_IO (3V3), never5VOUT. TMC I/O undervoltage reset covers the sub-POR region.
D_PD_VALID blocks the high-voltage PD gate node. U_PD_SCHMITT accepts slow open-drain edges and drives the NOR inputs; qualification includes VOL plus diode drop, leakage and unpowered operation.
D_PD_VALID: BAT54WS; blocks high-voltage PD gate node.
R_PD_PATH: 10 kohm; pulls missing-path flag high.
R_MOTOR_REQUEST: 10 kohm; motor request defaults off.
U_PD_SCHMITT: cleans three slow status/request edges.
C_PD_SCHMITT: 100 nF; Schmitt buffer supply bypass.
U_MOTOR_INTERLOCK: NOR; all three flags must be low.
C_MOTOR_INTERLOCK: 100 nF; local NOR supply bypass.
U_MOTOR_ENN: Schmitt NAND; request AND rail power-good.
C_MOTOR_ENN: 100 nF; final enable-gate supply bypass.
